scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.lint: biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false apps packages biome-plugins && oxfmt --check '**/*.md' '**/*.json' '**/*.yaml' '**/*.yml' && biome lint . && oxlint --deny-warnings && ruff format --check datasets && ruff check --no-fix datasets
scripts.fix: biome format --write apps packages biome-plugins && oxfmt --write '**/*.md' '**/*.json' '**/*.yaml' '**/*.yml' && oxlint --fix --deny-warnings && ruff format datasets && ruff check --fix datasets
scripts.test: bun --filter @lima-garbage/api test && bun --filter @lima-garbage/database test && bun --filter @lima-garbage/web test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/database/node_modules apps/citizen/node_modules bun.lock packages/database/bun.lock apps/citizen/bun.lock
scripts.datasets:dev: cd datasets && uv run marimo edit
scripts.datasets:dev-lan: cd datasets && uv run marimo edit --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.datasets:export: cd datasets && uv run marimo export html-wasm src/03-population-map.py -o src/output --mode run
scripts.datasets:export-page: cd datasets && uv run marimo export html src/03-population-map.py -o src/output/temp_index.html && uv run python scripts/prerender_marimo.py src/output/temp_index.html src/output/index.html
